pages.title: Singularity Energy Cell
pages.text: At the centre of this cell sits a tiny singularity, wrapped in cosmic neutronium. Energy falls into it and is held behind the horizon until it is needed. The casing never warms, though it carries more than any star.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)A black hole is the densest possible store of energy. Wrapping a Micro Singularity in cosmic neutronium around a vacuum cell gave me a battery whose capacity is limited only by its horizon.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Stellar Engineering.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omnium Energy Cell.
